note: Andorra keeps no free movement with the EU: a foreigner works there on a residence and work authorisation within the general quota the Government sets (Decree 350/2021 approving the Regulation on the general quota of residence and work authorisations, published in the BOPA of 3 November 2021, read from a copy since the BOPA's own copy wasn't found). No exemption for a performer's short engagement was found, so no days are modelled. Short engagement corrected 2026-11-01 from the permit research (papers.permits.AD): 30 calendar days in a calendar year of a foreign professional’s services need no immigration authorisation, only prior notice (read as 30 days within 365).
